dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth as an RFC 3339 full-date (yyyy-MM-dd, zero-padded); a time component is rejected

gender.description: Gender; free string validated against the shared reference list at the caller layer

orgId.description: Organisation id this user belongs to (org catalogue reference)

orgName.description: Display name of the organisation referenced by orgId

functionalRole.description: Functional role assigned to the user for the referenced organisation/catalogue

password.description: Plaintext password; BCrypt-hashed by the service before storage. Optional on update (omitted keeps the stored hash)

pin.description: Plaintext PIN; BCrypt-hashed by the service before storage. Optional on update (omitted keeps the stored hash)

location0Id.description: Identifier for the top-level (level 0) node of the location hierarchy

location0Name.description: Display name for the top-level (level 0) node of the location hierarchy

location1Id.description: Identifier for the level 1 node of the location hierarchy, nested under location0

location1Name.description: Display name for the level 1 node of the location hierarchy

location2Id.description: Identifier for the level 2 node of the location hierarchy, nested under location1

location2Name.description: Display name for the level 2 node of the location hierarchy

location3Id.description: Identifier for the level 3 node of the location hierarchy, nested under location2

location3Name.description: Display name for the level 3 node of the location hierarchy

location4Id.description: Identifier for the level 4 node of the location hierarchy, nested under location3

location4Name.description: Display name for the level 4 node of the location hierarchy

displayName.description: Optional display label for the user's functional role (e.g. 'FIELD_OFFICER'). Nullable

createdBy.description: User id of the creator (set by the portal/auth layer)

updatedBy.description: User id of the last updater (set by the portal/auth layer)
